steps.content: You've won, but the contamination hasn't slowed down. More and more roars of Corruptors can be heard from all directions.
As if controlled by a certain voice, they are determined to either drive you out of here or tear you into pieces. This evil will is beginning to weigh on your nerves.
It's starting again... You two, get out of here and don't look back.
I can't let anything happen to you two!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh—shut up! You refuse to leave; how can we run away without you!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: My mission is to follow you to the top of the tower and fight the final battle.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But the guy at the top of the tower is probably dead. Can we do it on our own?

options: We're not the only ones here
